principles.text: Capability that emerges from getting good at code spreads to every domain built on code; security prowess was not trained directly.
principles.quote: The security side seems to be an emergent behavior from getting good at code. They weren't trying to train it to be good at hacking, they were just trying to make it good at code

summary: Theo reacts to Anthropic's unreleased Claude Mythos preview and its system card, covering coding benchmark jumps, cybersecurity risk, Project Glasswing, and centralization of intelligence. It is mostly AI news and security commentary, with little durable business or growth insight.
title: Claude Mythos: a model too powerful to release and what it means for software security
